caption: The drawing depicts a single small pitcher placed on a rectangular wooden surface. The pitcher is bulbous with a wide body, a slightly tapered neck, and a rounded spout. It has a distinct handle on the right side, curving from the rim to the upper body. The pitcher is rendered in shades of brown and orange with darker speckles throughout, indicating a ceramic or clay material. The wooden surface beneath the pitcher is shaded with light and dark brown tones, featuring visible wood grain texture. Above the pitcher, the words "SMALL PITCHER" are printed in uppercase, serif letters in a muted greenish-blue color, evenly spaced against a plain, light beige background.
title: Small Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
